# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `fitmetrics` MCP server pointing at FitMetrics' hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://app.fitmetrics.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses a FitMetrics API key supplied by the user as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (`${FITMETRICS_API_KEY}`).
- Logo: FitMetrics' official mark, the `favicon.svg` from fitmetrics.ai.
